verdict.rationale: An online tax-services portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or command interface, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents conventional form-based Online Services features: payments, notices, Web File and calculators. Nothing shows the product accepting natural-language commands, and the agent-facing probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
